title: Marc Anthony & Nadia Ferreira Welcome Baby No. 2: ‘We Are on Cloud Nine’
summary: The newborn is the Puerto Rican singer's eighth child.
contentText:
Marc Anthony and Nadia Ferreira have welcomed their second child. 

The power couple shared the news—and revealed their baby girl’s name—in a joint Instagram post on Tuesday (July 21), stating: “What a huge blessing to be able to share the arrival of our precious MYLA with you all. You can’t imagine the happiness we have at home; we are on cloud nine.”

The caption accompanies a carousel of two photos that show the couple and their three-year-old son, Marco Antonio, surrounding the new bundle of joy.

Anthony and Ferreira first announced they were expecting their second child on Jan. 28, which also marked their third wedding anniversary. “What a wonderful gift life has given us. God is great. Marquito is going to be a big brother.”

The arrival of Myla marks Ferreira’s second baby and the singer’s eighth child, following his sons and daughters Arianna, Chase, Cristian, Ryan, twins Emme and Maximilian (whom he shares with actress, singer and ex-wife Jennifer Lopez ) and Marco.

The 57-year-old salsa singer got engaged to the 27-year-old Paraguayan model, who was first runner-up at the 2021 Miss Universe, in May 2022. They married on Jan. 28, 2023 at the Pérez Art Museum Miami (PAMM), with a star-studded guest list that included Romeo Santos, Marco Antonio Solís, Daddy Yankee, Maluma, Prince Royce, Luis Fonsi and Salma Hayek. Mexican entrepreneur Carlos Slim and soccer star David Beckham served as Anthony’s best men.

Anthony was previously married to Dayanara Torres (2000-2004), Lopez (2004-2014) and Shannon de Lima (2014-2017).
